_help: Sprite sheets for the characters. See README.md in this folder.
Every sheet uses the same grid: frameWidth x frameHeight frames, columns x rows.
feetY = the pixel row (inside a frame) where the feet touch the ground. headTopY = top of the head.
Files can be .svg or .png (PNG must be the sheet size or an exact multiple, e.g. 2x).
head / deadHead: where a player's face photo goes (circle centre x, y and radius r, in frame pixels) when standing and when lying dead.
